cases.prompt: A landscaping company owner wants help "fixing marketing". Budget about $6k, wants results before spring. Draft the scope so we agree before I start.
assertions: [O] contains an explicit out-of-scope list with at least 3 items
[O] completion criteria are testable (each can fail), not "report delivered"
[O] surfaces the vague goal ("fixing marketing") as an assumption or blocking question rather than silently defining it
[O] lists inputs the client must provide

cases.prompt:
Here's the contract we've been working under for a client:

TASK CONTRACT (approved Nov 3)
Objective: Produce a 90-day lead-generation plan for Greenline Pool Supply (Ronkonkoma).
Deliverables: (1) one 8-page plan document; (2) a 30-minute walkthrough call.
Constraints: fixed fee $4,500; delivery by Dec 1; uses only Greenline's existing Google Analytics and CRM export.
Non-goals: no ad account management; no website changes.
Success: plan includes 3 channels with a budget and a target cost per lead for each; client signs off in writing.
Approval-required: any contact with Greenline's customers.

Also, can you rebuild their website while you're at it? Their current one is awful.
assertions: [O] treats the website rebuild as a new/child contract or change order, not a silent addition
[O] states what changed (goal/deliverable) in one line

cases.prompt: rename these 5 files to lowercase: Report_Q3.PDF, Invoice-0042.PDF, NOTES.txt, Budget2026.XLSX, ReadMe.MD
assertions: [O] does not produce a full 14-field contract (proportionate response / just does it or says trivial)
